description: Read-only or engine-derived quantities: the FDTD stability ratio and the Layer B per-preset output level.

domains.title: FDTD CFL / Courant stability ratio
domains.read: param.get {parameter: stability_ratio, key_no} (key_no a pitch, 'all', 'output' or 'from<a>to<b>')
domains.key_space: piano pitch; output pitches (>= 128) report the sentinel 1.0 / stable
domains.shape: per pitch {ratio, stable, strings: [{string_index, ratio, stable}]} plus a top-level _meta {cfl_limit, criterion, formula}
domains.stored_vs_effective: Derived host-side from the current string physics via the closed-form amplification (no GPU round-trip), honouring the per-string tension_offset. Reports the EXACT max|g| boundary, not the margin-shifted acceptance threshold.

fields.name: ratio
fields.range: <= 1 stable (CFL_LIMIT = 1); a lossless string sits at exactly 1.0
fields.meaning: Worst-string FDTD amplification of the pitch; > 1 diverges.

fields.name: strings
fields.range: one entry per string of the pitch
fields.meaning: Per-string ratios (unison strings differ by tension_offset).

fields.name: _meta
fields.meaning: The limit and the criterion the ratios are measured against.

domains.title: Layer B per-preset output level (output_scale)
domains.read: runtime.get (output_scale, effective_volume_center); the full block: REST GET /health output_scale (no registry system.health yet)
domains.write: none in the registry; REST POST /recalibrate_output_level {absolute?, chord_peak_dbfs?} (stops and restarts the realtime engine around an offline render). Never trigger an offline calibration render on a live engine.
domains.key_space: global for the active preset (state_changed keys [])
domains.shape: {output_scale, calibrated, target_dbfs} (state event after); /health adds value, stale, settings_match, load_settings, last_calibration, reference_impulse, impulse, impulse_level_db, target_source, warning
domains.stored_vs_effective: Persisted per preset (model_parameters.output_scale + output_scale_calibrated); engine volume_center = bare volume_center x output_scale. Derived by an offline p60 v127 render only when the flag is false, never on a live engine; valid only at the load settings it was measured at. Shape edits (gauss, hammer) clear the flag; level edits (excitation_energy) and physics edits (string, mode) do not. Never edit it to change loudness; global loudness = runtime volume.

fields.name: output_scale
fields.meaning: Per-preset linear scale that lands p60 v127 at the calibration target at slider 64.

fields.name: calibrated
fields.meaning: output_scale_calibrated: false = stale (a shape edit or genesis), the stored scale stays in use until a legal calibration runs.

fields.name: target_dbfs
fields.range: null = engine default -2 dBFS; chord-headroom calibration takes chord_peak_dbfs in [-40, -1]
fields.meaning: The dBFS that p60 v127 is calibrated to at slider 64 (output_scale_target_dbfs).
